name: check_job_status tmux unreliable
description: check_job_status using tmux session name can falsely report process dead when tmux dies but the underlying process survives
type: feedback
---

Do not rely solely on `check_job_status` with tmux session name to determine if a process is alive. Tmux sessions can die independently of the spawned process (e.g., eval completes but tmux already exited, or tmux crashes while process continues).

**Why:** On 2026-05-15, `check_job_status(pid="exp_001_eval_3B_d000_v2_para_aligned_v3")` returned `not_found` because the tmux session was dead, but `ps` and `nvidia-smi` showed the process (PID 479906) alive at 90% GPU utilization. This caused a false DONE(failed) marking and an unnecessary retry attempt.

**How to apply:** Before marking any experiment as failed based on check_job_status, always verify with a Worker that runs both `ps aux | grep evaluate.py` and `nvidia-smi` on the target GPU. Only mark failed when BOTH confirm no process exists.
